title: Harbor and Uniform
author: Gideon Nystrom
blurb: Hazel Underhill, a pearl diver's child indentured to a trading company, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
